I was sent wire forms at one stage,It came to the last fee payment, and I thought that was it I would get my money but then I had to pay that fee 15 more times.  I said I could not pay and was then told I could pay 10 instalments with a guarantee of payment from my account manager. Of course, by this time I knew it was not for real as I started to look into things and I found a Scamadivser email, which I did not receive a long while ago, and found out what I should have seen before.
